definitions.explanation: The electrical signals produced by the brain, measurable through electroencephalography (EEG). Used in medical, scientific, and popular contexts.

examples.japanese: {脳波|のうは}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測定|そくてい}→測定：04398_sokutei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{睡眠中|すいみんちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{脳波|のうは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パターン→パターン：05456_pataan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: We examined brain wave patterns during sleep.

examples.japanese: {脳波|のうは}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}つからなかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: The brain wave test results showed no abnormalities.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in medical contexts ({脳波|のうは}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ — EEG test) as well as popular science and technology discussions. Also appears in casual contexts related to brain-computer interfaces and neuroscience topics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脳波|のうは}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ (EEG test, brain wave test)
- {脳波|のうは}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測定|そくてい}→測定：04398_sokutei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to measure brain waves)
- {脳波|のうは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パターン→パターン：05456_pataan⟧ (brain wave pattern)
- アルファ{波|は} (alpha waves)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脳|のう}→脳：03537_nou⟧: brain — the organ itself
- {脳波|のうは}: brain waves — the electrical signals it produces
